title: Android Enterprise Connection & Managed Google Play Setup in Intune
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Microsoft Android implementation).

Intune admin center / Microsoft Graph / managed Google Play / Google Admin console authored at exact detail from Microsoft & Google public docs. The Android Management API (AMAPI) transition, web/account-driven enrollment, and whether a change triggers device RE-ENROLLMENT are actively evolving — cited or flagged 'verify against current Microsoft guidance / your tenant', never asserted from memory or invented. OEM (Samsung Knox/Zebra) + third-party apps at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell (Graph); no hardcoded credentials/secrets. No client names.
hook: Stand up Android Enterprise in Intune — the right binding and enrollment profiles
problem: Android management in Intune starts with one thing done correctly: the managed Google Play binding and the enrollment model. Get it wrong and nothing enrolls. This solution connects Intune to managed Google Play (the account-enterprise model for tenants without Google Workspace), then stands up the enrollment profiles — personally-owned work profile (BYOD), fully managed, corporate-owned work profile, and dedicated/COSU — with the enrollment restrictions, so the right devices enroll the right way.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the managed Google Play binding, the four Android Enterprise enrollment models and when to use each, and the Assess→Configure→Pilot→Validate→Expand model.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Intune + Android Enterprise licensing, admin roles, the binding-model decision, network endpoints).

Implementation Guide — connect managed Google Play, configure enrollment restrictions + platform settings, create the enrollment profiles for each model, and validate a pilot enrollment — pilot-first, each profile named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Microsoft Graph / Intune automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (binding healthy, each enrollment model works, restrictions enforced) plus Best Practices for a clean Android Enterprise foundation.
short: Connect Intune to managed Google Play and stand up the Android Enterprise enrollment profiles (work profile, fully managed, corporate-owned work profile, dedicated/COSU) with enrollment restrictions — the foundation the rest of Android management builds on. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Connect Intune to managed Google Play and stand up the Android Enterprise enrollment profiles (work profile, fully managed, corporate-owned work profile, dedicated/COSU) with enrollment restrictions — the Android management foundation.
